title: Make Falcon IDs logo transparent and replace all 'role-play' wording with 'novelty' site-wide

requirements.text: Remove the white background from the existing Falcon IDs logo asset by generating a transparent-background version and update all frontend references to use the transparent logo file.

quotes: The logo has a white background behind it. Remove that also use the logo I sent you brand name is. Falcon IDs

acceptanceCriteria: A new transparent logo image exists under frontend/public/assets/generated and visually has no white background.
All pages/components that render the logo (e.g., header and landing hero) reference the new transparent logo filename.
The rendered logo blends correctly on dark backgrounds with no visible white box/padding artifact.
No broken image links occur in the header or landing page after the filename switch.

requirements.text: Replace the term "role-play" (including variants like "roleplay", "ROLEPLAY") with "novelty" in all user-facing website copy, disclaimers, banners, and ID card watermark text while keeping the meaning that the IDs are not real identification.

quotes: replace the word role-play everywhere on the website with novelty because we’re still shipping them but their novelty so we are a novel ID selling website

acceptanceCriteria: All user-visible occurrences of "role-play"/"roleplay"/"ROLEPLAY" across the UI are replaced with "novelty"/"NOVELTY" as appropriate.
Centralized copy in frontend/src/content/copy.ts no longer contains "roleplay" wording and instead uses "novelty" wording.
The ID card watermark (frontend/src/components/IdWatermark.tsx) no longer says "ROLEPLAY ONLY" and instead uses "NOVELTY" wording while still stating it is not valid identification.

The disclaimer banner component (frontend/src/components/RoleplayDisclaimerBanner.tsx) no longer displays "ROLEPLAY USE ONLY" and is updated to "NOVELTY USE ONLY" (component may be renamed, but functionality and rendering remain intact).
Landing page hero and disclaimer sections (frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx) no longer describe the service as "roleplay" and instead describe it as "novelty".
New order page copy (e.g., shipping section title and subtitle/disclaimer sourced from COPY) no longer includes "Roleplay" phrasing and instead uses "Novelty" phrasing.

requirements.text: Ensure the brand name is consistently presented as "Falcon IDs" (including in long-form disclaimers currently referencing "RF-FALCON-IDS") across user-facing text where the company/service name is mentioned.
acceptanceCriteria: Any long-form disclaimers/copy that mention "RF-FALCON-IDS" are updated to say "Falcon IDs" (or "FALCON IDs" if matching existing stylistic capitalization) consistently.
The logo alt text remains correct for accessibility and reflects the brand name (e.g., "Falcon IDs"/"FALCON IDs").
Browser tab title remains branded for Falcon IDs (frontend/index.html).

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (Shadcn components); compose them instead.
Do not modify immutable hook entrypoints listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT (e.g., frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts(x), frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx).
Backend remains single-actor; only modify backend files if absolutely required for this request.
nonGoals: Changing order/payment/shipping functionality or any backend order logic.
Adding new authentication methods (only Internet Identity remains).
Major redesign of the site theme beyond text and logo asset updates.

edits: Remove the white background and make the logo background transparent (falcon-ids-logo.dim_1200x300.png > falcon-ids-logo-transparent.dim_1200x300.png)
